tools.name: simulate-dividends
tools.description:
Dividend calculator: simulates building a dividend stock portfolio over several years, with dividend reinvestment (DRIP) and monthly contributions, to estimate future passive income. This is the calculation behind the RendementBourse dividend simulator.

Model: each year, dividends net of fees and contributions are reinvested at the target yield, and dividends already acquired grow at the given rate. Share prices are assumed constant and taxes are not taken into account. Amounts are in euros.

Returns the capital and annual dividend reached at the end of the period, total contributions, dividends received and fees, and a year-by-year breakdown. It is a constant-assumption projection, not a forecast or investment advice.

monthlyContribution.description: Amount invested each month, in euros (0 to 100,000)

dividendYield.description: Target dividend yield, in % per year (0 to 20)

fees.description: Fees charged on each amount invested, in % (0 to 5)

years.description: Length of the simulation, in years (1 to 40)
